## Invitations

The outreach invitation activity resulted in 2446 people being invited. A total of 885 people attended, representing an attendance rate of 36.2 per cent. This result provides a clear summary of participation among those who received an invitation and supports ongoing review of engagement with the outreach process.

The attendance figure should be considered alongside the invitation total when assessing the reach of the activity. Recording both measures supports consistent reporting and helps identify opportunities to improve participation in future outreach work.

## Contact

SMS contact was used to reach 2112 invitees. Reminder messages were also sent to 2112 invitees, providing an additional prompt to support attendance. The use of both initial SMS contact and reminders forms part of the communication approach for the outreach activity.

Follow-up contact continues for people who did not attend their scheduled appointments. This provides an opportunity to maintain engagement and offer further support where appropriate.
